answer: The EDPB ChatGPT Taskforce Report states that the responsibility for ensuring compliance with GDPR should not be transferred to data subjects. It emphasizes that if ChatGPT is made available to the public, it should be assumed that individuals will input personal data. OpenAI remains responsible for complying with the GDPR, even if certain personal data inputs were prohibited. The report highlights that OpenAI should not argue that the input of personal data was prohibited in the first place, indicating that the responsibility lies with OpenAI as the controller.
